text:
maya: heads up — after the q8 bring-up on staging we saw a weird spike in label flips on a small slice of prompts (short, multi-turn clarifications). thinking we should carve out a small 'edgebank' seed set to drive quick regression tests and relabel. any objections?
sam: agree, saw the same in the bench report. can we make it <1k examples so labeling turnaround is fast? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
leo: fine with <1k. we should dedupe by fingerprint and by normalized prompt (strip punctuation + lower). I can share a quick fingerprint sql.
priya: +1. also want to make sure we include some quant-specific cases (repeats + long ctx). otherwise regressions hide in tail.
maya: plan: 1) sample 800 candidate examples from prod harvest; 2) dedupe & normalize; 3) run embedding-fingerprint clustering; 4) take top 300 high-risk + 200 stratified rare ops + 300 random = 800; 5) send to labeler pool as "edgebank:phase1" small gold. timeline 3 business days.
taylor: capacity check — we can do 800 with 2 labelers in ~48 hrs if we batch. I can allocate Monday-Tuesday. assign @taylor to queue. :white_check_mark:
sam: can we get deterministic sampling seed? mention it in the export so quant bench is repeatable. example seed: 42.
leo: here's the dedupe query I'll run on the harvest table:
```sql
-- simplified
SELECT id, regexp_replace(lower(prompt), '[^a-z0-9 ]', '', 'g') AS norm
FROM harvest
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days';
```
maya: +1. for fingerprinting use embedding cosine cluster with threshold 0.88. prefer we save cluster_id for traceability.
priya: labeling spec: two-pass labeling. first pass single annotator categorizes case_type (clarification, hallucination-trigger, format-edge). second pass blind QA on 20% random. any objections?
taylor: sounds good. I'll create a queue tag `edgebank_phase1` and set QA=20%. annotator-bot will post completion pings.
annotator-bot: created queue edgebank_phase1 with 800 tasks, QA_rate=0.2, assignees=[taylor]. ETA 48h.
maya: once labeled, I'll run the mini-eval against opt-6b-q8 and opt-6b-fp16 and produce a diff report (accuracy / pass@ / top-1 vs baseline). if we see >5% flip rate we pause rollout and run rollback canary.
sam: also add a short promptset audit to catch prefix leakage (we had one case where system prompt leaked into examples). small script to grep for system tokens before labeling.
leo: added script snippet to repo: 
```python
import re
def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]", "", s.lower())
```
I'll push a PR and attach the sampling seed & cluster IDs.
maya: perfect. I'm marking owner=maya, reviewer=leo, label-flow=taylor. tagging @priya for QA plan. Will post results in this thread. :rocket:
priya: thanks — will prep the eval checklist. one ask: include 30 synthetic paraphrases of each high-risk example to stress quantization brittleness.
maya: noted. I'll add paraphrase augmentation step in the pipeline.
taylor: queue assigned, start Monday. will ping here when 50% done.
sam: thanks team. short and surgical — this should surface regressions fast.
maya: end-to-end ETA: 5 business days incl. eval & report. closing loop here, will update.
